## Problem and behavior change

Describe the trigger and the observable result.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and any limitations. For visual changes, attach redacted or synthetic screenshots; for math/content changes, explain how correctness was reviewed.

- [ ] Private conversations, attachments, credentials and local font files are excluded.
- [ ] Style selection and HTML approval behavior are preserved or intentionally documented.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
